channel.title: Mauritius - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Mauritius, every source cited.

item.title: Mauritius unionists march on cost of living
item.description: Workers in Port-Louis protested rising prices, poor working conditions, and water shortages.

item.title: Air Mauritius reports Rs 4.1 billion profit for 2025-2026
item.description: The national airline's equity has turned positive, reaching Rs 1.37 billion after being negative since the pandemic.

item.title: Mauritius federation calls for national unity at Divali event
item.description: The Mauritius Sanatan Dharma Temples Federation unveiled plans for new spiritual projects and an expanded education program.

item.title: Two inmates escape Rivière-des-Anguilles police station
item.description: Police recaptured Stéphane Perrine, 29, and Jeff Wendy Leonel Domingue, 35, on November 1.

item.title: MFA youth league sees over 50 goals scored
item.description: Flacq U15 boys secured the largest victory with a 7-0 win against Vacoas.
